description: This file defines the interface for a reftable iterator, including structures, function prototypes for navigating and reading ref and log records within a reftable data structure.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_seek_ref
methods.description: Position the iterator at the reference record with the specified name.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_next_ref
methods.description: Retrieve the next reference record. Returns negative on error, zero if successful, positive if iteration has ended.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_seek_log_at
methods.description: Position the iterator at the log record with the specified name and update index.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_seek_log
methods.description: Position the iterator at the newest log record with the given name.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_next_log
methods.description: Retrieve the next log record. Returns negative on error, zero if successful, positive if iteration has ended.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_destroy
methods.description: Release resources associated with the iterator.
